selection.selected_intervention: Shared one-allocation string storage and direct concatenation, with VM concatenation routed through the same checked runtime owner.
evidence: Both exact counter replays agree for all four workloads and both engines.
report-concat performs 60002 concatenations and copies 1356336482 bytes into temporary concatenation buffers in each engine, then copies those bytes again into managed strings.
Repeated Native sampling attributes 2060 of 2560 exclusive samples to memmove; fresh VM sampling attributes 162 of 251 samples to memmove. Counts and samples are not acceptance timings.
word-frequency creates 400100 managed strings in Native and 500122 in VM; normalize-title creates 152632 and 162656. Current nonempty string storage uses separate header and byte-buffer allocations.
constraints: Keep the string/reference representation, logical managed-byte accounting, numeric heap cap and root/GC/provenance checks.
Preserve empty-string byte-view behavior, exact operation validation/error ordering, transactional result publication, aliased input roots and every reachable allocation-failure path.
Use independently owned runtime/VM files; native and VM must consume the same string construction mechanism. No workload names or argument specialization.
Before implementation declare Native and VM improvement targets, unchanged all32 regression gates, host-load gate, supported-platform tests and publication deadline.
next_separate_targets: JIT string comparison/collection-read coverage and repeated checked string resolution, especially title-search-100k.
Delimiter scan/memcmp cost in word-frequency. These are not bundled into the selected storage intervention.
coverage_limits: Initial short Native profiles had insufficient samples; repeated-entry profiles are diagnostic and retain all 192 checked outcomes.
One sampled label in repeated word-frequency resolves to _dyld_start; attribution is not treated as exact CPU percentages.
selection.user_reporting: A fresh accepted-code fiveway is requested next; the rejected preparation candidate is excluded.
